verdict.rationale: Galileo ingests customer traces, datasets and annotations, so whether that data trains AI models is a fair privacy question for this product. The evidence pack has no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training guarantee, or a data-usage policy. The mention of distilling evals into Luna models describes a product feature, not a control preventing customer data from being used for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
